findings: AscendRoutedExperts._select_experts calls the original router,then indexes topk_ids through log2phy when present. W8A8.apply passes these IDs to build_fused_experts_input; this builder preserves IDs and only stores expert_map in routing metadata. FusedMC2CommImpl passes topk_ids directly into dispatch_ffn_combine; the viewed native call has no separate expert-map argument.

Existing init_eplb_config supports expert_map_path and returns log2phy. With EP>1, no file and dynamic_eplb false, it returns a linear expert map and log2phy=None. A static custom map capability therefore exists in source; do not call all remapping a wholly absent ABI. Source presence alone does not prove a usable post-load migration or observed activation.

ExpertMapManager.determine_expert_map supports linear and round_robin,not an arbitrary array through its placement_strategy string. Ascend expert_map_path/log2phy is a separate mechanism. Backend fallbacks for round_robin are guarded; changing a placement string is not proof of the recorded MC2 route/weight contract.

AscendRoutedExperts inherits RoutedExperts.weight_loader (no override in the viewed Ascend file). The loader first maps global expert ID through ExpertMapManager to a local physical slot and skips nonlocal experts. Ascend init_eplb deliberately preserves this physical loading map until checkpoint loading finishes. The exact post-load reconciliation of a custom Ascend map with weights remains a distinct missing edge.

DeepseekV41MoE creates hash routing only for layer_idx<num_hash_layers and not is_draft_layer. Hash layers have tid2eid; ordinary layers have e_score_correction_bias. The same post-router ID relabel can preserve the original selection in either path,provided probabilities/order and expert functions stay paired. Do not permute score columns and silently change ties or hash selection.

W8A8 post-load processing transposes/casts both weights to the required format,retains floating scale views and creates fused INT64 scale tensors for enable_fused_mc2=1. get_eplb_weight_views includes both weight tensors,float scale views,and fused scale views when present. Weight-list and CANN MegaMoe branches retain different payload representations. Move/rebuild all paired payloads; the prior native INT8+INT64 operand-byte count is not total resident memory.

The dispatch branch under enable_fused_mc2=1 and use_mega_moe false is separate from _apply_cann_mega_moe. Bias placeholders,activation/SwiGLU variants,mc2_mask,expert-count buffers and world/group remain guarded. The current excerpt does not attest every historical binary/flag value.

Force-EPLB/random load-balance branches occur after log2phy in _select_experts. They change expert IDs,so cannot be treated as semantics-preserving performance alternatives without an explicit model contract.
